cacheIsolation.scope: Combined admission plus budget policy using complete cache classes on the same current renderer; original 48 MiB versus explicitly recorded candidate budget (default 16 MiB). Not a same-budget admission comparison; no production integration or per-frame observer. Cache counters, true Canvas misses and CPU ownership may change and are not asserted equal. PNG pixels, picking, facts and GPU page/upload behavior require separate measured comparison, not assumptions.

moduleSetup.setup: Vite pre-resolve selects the complete class module only for the current PaintedCardBatches ./card-raster-cache import. No get-only override, instance monkey patch or per-frame observer.

method: Unprofiled combined admission-and-budget CardRasterCache policy (candidate), not production integration and not a same-budget admission ablation. Both sides retain identical current production peak accounting, mask packing, art, thresholds, allocation, transfer, draw order, timers and completion method. Vite redirects only current PaintedCardBatches './card-raster-cache' to the frozen 5b original module or archived standalone candidate class; all methods and defaults come from that complete class. The frozen original must equal current cache source bytes. Both external modules are imported before cycles without instantiating classes. Original complete class has a 50331648-byte (48 MiB) budget; candidate complete class is expected to supply 16777216 bytes (default 16777216, 16 MiB). The CLI budget argument validates, never mutates, the constructor default. Before/empty/returned counters strictly validate the selected budget and encoded payload bytes. Encoded entries and candidate probation entries have separately reported 1024 bounds; original has no probation table. Scratch/JS metadata are not claimed bounded by encoded payload budget. This measures the joint admission and budget policy, not either factor in isolation. No per-frame instrumentation is introduced. Cache statistics, true Canvas miss counts and CPU ownership may differ and remain fully reported. Equal PNG RGBA, masked picking, snapshot facts and requested times are correctness requirements to verify separately; page and upload behavior must also be compared from evidence rather than assumed equal. Frozen clocks remain 18 preparation draws at n=0..51, 60 CPU warmups, 360 paced=true CPU samples at n=114 and 18 real frames at n=480, preserving the original first cold-stream sample and empty/return probes. Default one-lifetime pilot; repeat count 2 is recorded explicitly. Any later ABBA is externally scheduled. The original preparation, warmup, first cold sample and all sample clocks are retained without selection. CPU samples retain the original renderer.render no-op; real complete wall includes Canvas/submission/GPU completion/scheduler overhead. No new observer or picking calls. Output directories are exclusive to preserve prior headers and failed evidence.
